_about: CYCLE2 S1 soil-contact cover retrieval fixture. Every chunk body is synthetic (FIXTURE-e-20260928), invented project Example Harbour Works; no text copied from a client document. Shape kept from the live trace (ids only): a specification clause that defers the cover to the drawings and states no cover millimetre; three footing-cover drawing chunks (100 mm bottom of footings) that share the question's words (concrete cover, cast, contact with soil); a high-cosine 50 mm 'not in contact' drawing note; and the two chunks that carry the 75 mm soil-contact figure in the document's OWN words (cover to reinforcement, in contact with soil) - a general note in a drawings volume and a sheet whose file name does not say drawing. The test adds synthetic filler chunks so the two 75 mm chunks sit outside both 50-deep hybrid legs, as on the live corpus.

chunks.text: 3.1.25.8 Fixing of bars. Binding wire shall be 1.4 mm in diameter and the ends turned inward. Spacer blocks fixed to the reinforcement shall give the cover specified in this volume, on the Drawings or as the engineer directs. This clause states no cover millimetre.
